verdict.rationale: Fenwick documents a dedicated Privacy & Cybersecurity practice with an integrated team of lawyers and former industry privacy and cybersecurity officers. That team provides comprehensive compliance, assessment and implementation-focused services, which covers the core of the story. missing for 10: explicit mention of the specific regimes counseled on (GDPR, CCPA, DPDP or equivalents), detail on practice scope or matters, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice

citations.quote: Fenwick has built an integrated team of lawyers and former industry privacy and cybersecurity officers who provide comprehensive compliance, assessment and legal 'boutique' services focused on implementation.
